name: default-review-rubric

categories.label: Acceptance Criteria Pass Rate
categories.description: Fraction of acceptance criteria that PASS with concrete evidence. All must pass for Ready status.

categories.label: Technical Specification Conformance
categories.description: Files exist at stated paths, interfaces match signatures, data shapes match schemas, technology constraints honored.

categories.label: Test Requirements Coverage
categories.description: All named test cases exist, contain the described assertion, and pass.

categories.label: Out of Scope Discipline
categories.description: Implementation contains nothing listed in Out of Scope. No scope creep introduced.

categories.label: Edge Case and Error Handling
categories.description: Every edge case and error mode named in Agent Notes is handled as specified.

categories.label: Security Requirements
categories.description: All security constraints named in Agent Notes are implemented and verifiable.

categories.label: Goal Alignment
categories.description: The deliverable matches the Description field — produces the named artifact solving the stated problem.

auto_fail_conditions: Any file listed in 'Files to create' does not exist
Any file listed in 'Files that must NOT be touched' was modified
Any named test case is missing or fails
Any feature listed in Out of Scope is present in the implementation
